name: io.github.dplusf/monapi
title: monapi
description: Allow, challenge or block an email, IP or domain — with the signals behind the verdict

environmentVariables.name: MONAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key the engine accepts. On a self-hosted instance these come from BOOTSTRAP_API_KEYS.

environmentVariables.name: MONAPI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the monapi engine. Point this at your own instance.

environmentVariables.name: MONAPI_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Policy profile used when a call does not name one: how strictly the same signals are judged.
